jobs.occupation: Senior Global Pricing Operations Partner (m/f/d) (Kalkulator/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Global Pricing Operations Partner (m/f/d) who is analytical, strategic and collaborative to join us in our Pricing Operations and Analytics team.About the roleAs Senior Global Pricing Operations Partner, you will lead the end-to-end assessment of complex and strategically important pricing requests. You will guide affiliates and global stakeholders on pricing governance, processes and tools while evaluating financial and cross-market implications. You will develop pricing policies for key brands, ensure high-quality pricing data and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations. In addition, you will lead strategic pricing operations projects, improve digital workflows and support the development of other Pricing Operations Partners.Who you’ll work withYou will work in a global, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with affiliates and regional and global stakeholders. This includes country pricing and market access teams, regional Access and Pricing teams, Global Asset Teams (including the Asset Payer Heads), Global Strategic Pricing and Finance. As a key Pricing Operations contact, you will support business-case owners throughout pricing assessments and collaborate with relevant governance stakeholders (Regional and Global Pricing Committees and Pricing Board) on critical pricing decisions. You will also coach Pricing Operations Partners, providing guidance and ensuring consistently high-quality analyses and submissions. You will report to the Global Pricing Operations Team Lead.What you’ll do- You are the main global point of contact for operational pricing questions and processes of your assigned affiliates.- You guide affiliates to build business cases with the necessary analytics, ensure stakeholder alignment and keep all teams on track with decision-making timelines.- You assess the financial and cross-market implications and risks of pricing requests and escalate them when needed.- You develop in-market pricing policies for assigned brands.- You monitor price changes, ensure pricing decisions are documented and up to date in the system, and provide quarterly reports on price changes and their impact.- You lead strategic projects to improve pricing tools, processes, automation and digital workflows, while coaching Pricing Operations Partners to ensure high-quality analyses and submissions.Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, economics, finance, business or data analytics.- At least five years’ relevant pricing, market access, health economics or finance experience.- Strong pharmaceutical pricing expertise, including governance and cross-market implications.- Proven experience leading complex, high-impact or cross-market pricing cases.- Strong analytical, project management, stakeholder management and communication skills.- Excellent written and verbal English skills in global, cross-functional environments.

jobs.occupation: Inhouse Consultant SAP Controlling(CO) / S/4HANA (m/w/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsamDeine Aufgaben- Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Controlling- und Finance-Teams zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in effiziente und nachhaltige SAP-Lösungen.- Du gestaltest und optimierst SAP-CO-Prozesse, insbesondere in den Bereichen Produktkostenrechnung, Kostenstellenrechnung, Innenaufträge, CO-PA, Planung, Forecasting und Reporting.- Du wirkst aktiv an unserer SAP-S/4HANA-Transformation mit und gestaltest das zukünftige globale Finance-&-Controlling-Template mit.- Du konfigurierst und entwickelst SAP CO weiter und stellst dabei eine reibungslose Integration mit SAP FI und angrenzenden Anwendungen sicher.- Du treibst die Standardisierung, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Prozesse in einer internationalen Organisation voran.- Du unterstützt SAP-Implementierungen, Rollouts, Weiterentwicklungen und Transformationsprojekte.- Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams und externen Partnern an unseren internationalen Standorten zusammen.Dein Profil- Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich SAP FI/CO, mit einem klaren Schwerpunkt auf SAP Controlling (CO).- Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktkostenrechnung, Kostenstellenrechnung, Innenaufträgen, CO-PA, Planung, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Reporting mit.- Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Customizing von SAP CO sowie ein gutes Verständnis der Integration zwischen FI und CO.- Du hast Erfahrung mit SAP ECC und SAP S/4HANA, idealerweise im Rahmen einer S/4HANA-Transformation oder -Migration.- Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Unternehmen ist von Vorteil.- Du verstehst komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen und kannst diese in pragmatische und nachhaltige SAP-Lösungen übersetzen.- Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Stakeholder-Management in einem internationalen Umfeld.- Eine proaktive, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein zeichnen dich aus.- Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsamEnglish VersionOur mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Together, We Shape the FutureYour Responsibilities- Partner with Controlling and Finance teams to translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions.- Design and optimize SAP CO processes, particularly in product costing, CO-PA, cost center accounting, planning, forecasting, and reporting.- Contribute to our SAP S/4HANA transformation and help shape the future global Finance & Controlling template.- Configure and enhance SAP CO while ensuring effective integration with SAP FI and surrounding applications.- Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across our international organization.- Support SAP implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and transformation projects.- Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, and external partners across multiple countries.Your Profile- Several years of experience with SAP CO/FI, with particular strength in Controlling.- Strong functional knowledge of product costing, cost center accounting, internal orders, CO-PA, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.- Hands-on SAP CO customizing experience and a good understanding of FI/CO integration.- Experience with SAP ECC and S/4HANA, ideally including an S/4HANA migration or transformation.- Manufacturing or industrial experience is a strong advantage.- Ability to understand business challenges and translate them into practical SAP solutions.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.- Proactive, independent, and solution-oriented working style.- Business-fluent English.At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. With our well-known brands TOI TOI® and DIXI®, we provide essential services and innovative solutions to customers across a wide range of industries.As an international group, we are committed to continuously improving the way we work, embracing digital transformation and leveraging new technologies to drive operational excellence.Now, we are taking the next step in our digital journey - and AI will play a key role.We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on AI Transformation Manager (m/f/d) to help shape and drive our Group-wide AI initiatives. jobs.occupation: Packaging & Automation Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Verpackungstechnik)
jobs.description: Overview   At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.  We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.  At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.  Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. ‎About the opportunity At QIAGEN, we are committed to making improvements in life possible. As a Packaging Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, industrializing, and continuously improving packaging solutions across our Diagnostics and Life Sciences portfolio. As a subject matter expert for packaging technologies, you will provide technical guidance to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing partners, and suppliers, ensuring robust, scalable, compliant, and cost-effective solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Combining packaging development, supplier engineering, manufacturing implementation, and automation, you will contribute to new product introductions, drive packaging innovation, and support automation projects across our global manufacturing and supplier network. Your tasks include * Leading packaging development and industrialization for new and existing products, from concept and material selection through qualification and commercial implementation.* Driving packaging automation projects at QIAGEN and supplier sites, including equipment implementation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ activities.* Providing technical packaging expertise to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.* Optimizing packaging materials and processes for product protection, quality, sustainability, regulatory compliance, efficiency, and cost.* Driving continuous improvement, root cause investigations, standardization, and the evaluation and implementation of innovative packaging technologies. Your profile * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* Several years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, or industrialization.* Strong expertise in packaging materials, technologies, manufacturing processes, and transport requirements, ideally including ISTA and IATA.* Experience with automated packaging equipment and equipment implementation, including FAT/SAT and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ, preferably within a GMP or similarly regulated environment.* Experience managing technical projects and collaborating with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional teams; experience in diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or life sciences is an advantage.* Knowledge of packaging qualification, risk management, FMEA, DoE, process capability, sustainability, and global manufacturing transfer is advantageous.* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English; German is an advantage and occasional travel is expected.What we offer   * Bonus/Commission  * Local benefits   * Referral Program  * Volunteer Day  * Internal Academy (QIALearn)   * Employee Assistance Program   * Hybrid work (conditional to your role)  Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.    QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.
